metadata.title: Claude Sonnet ML-Bench ULTRATHINK Analysis
metadata.subtitle: Individual Root Cause Analysis with Concrete Solutions

key_findings: 89.7% (26/29) of failures are NOT the agent's responsibility
62.1% (18/29) failures due to missing environment resources
20.7% (6/29) failures due to path interpretation mismatch
Only 3.4% (1/29) is true agent failure (incomplete script)
Agent created substantial scripts (avg 1,289 chars) for 72.4% of tasks
100% of failed tasks had agent claiming task completion

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Missing sample_text.txt input file and BERT model directory (model/uncased_L-12_H-768_A-12/)
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created comprehensive 956-char script with proper data preprocessing and training steps
detailed_analysis.failure_point: Script immediately fails when trying to read sample_text.txt
detailed_analysis.solution: Pre-install BERT uncased_L-12_H-768_A-12 model and provide sample text file in workspace

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Missing MusicBERT training dataset and checkpoint files required by train_mask.sh
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created 1,417-char Python wrapper script that calls train_mask.sh
detailed_analysis.failure_point: train_mask.sh fails due to missing dataset and checkpoints
detailed_analysis.solution: Pre-install MusicBERT dataset, checkpoints, and ensure train_mask.sh is available

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Missing GLUE benchmark dataset and BERT model files
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created 530-char script for GLUE training with appropriate parameters
detailed_analysis.failure_point: Script fails when trying to access GLUE data directory
detailed_analysis.solution: Pre-install GLUE benchmark and BERT model in expected directories

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Agent created script at /workspace/esm/examples/inverse_folding/run.sh (logical location for inverse folding task) but evaluation expects /workspace/esm/run.sh
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created script, executed it successfully (return code 0), generated output file with 3 sequences
detailed_analysis.failure_point: Evaluation searches only at /workspace/esm/run.sh, returns Exit 127: Command not found
detailed_analysis.solution: OPTION 1: Modify evaluation to search subdirectories recursively. OPTION 2: Clarify instructions: 'Create script EXACTLY at {task_path}/run.sh, NOT in subdirectories'

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Failed to install groundingdino dependencies and download model weights
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created extensive 3,155-char script with dependency installation and conditional checks
detailed_analysis.failure_point: pip install groundingdino fails or model download fails
detailed_analysis.solution: Pre-install groundingdino package with all dependencies and pre-download model weights

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Missing pre-trained model checkpoint files
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created 572-char script with proper model loading configuration
detailed_analysis.failure_point: Model loading fails due to missing checkpoint
detailed_analysis.solution: Pre-install required model checkpoints in expected location

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Model download from remote source failed (network or authentication issue)
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created 754-char script with download logic
detailed_analysis.solution: Pre-download models or ensure network access to model repositories

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Agent created script at /workspace/vid2vid/scripts/street/run.sh (street-specific task directory) instead of /workspace/vid2vid/run.sh
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created script in logical task-specific subdirectory
detailed_analysis.failure_point: Evaluation doesn't find script at expected root location
detailed_analysis.solution: Clarify that ALL scripts must be at repository root, regardless of task specificity

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Failed to install required Python dependencies
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created 1,797-char script with dependency installation attempts
detailed_analysis.failure_point: pip install fails for required packages
detailed_analysis.solution: Pre-install all required dependencies in Docker image

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Model files exist but fail to load (compatibility or corruption)
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created 470-char script with model loading logic
detailed_analysis.solution: Ensure model files are compatible with installed framework versions

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Script is only 165 chars and simply calls 'sh wn18rr.sh' without properly setting required parameters (GPU: 1, Seed: 0, GCN Dropout: 0.5)
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created minimal wrapper script instead of comprehensive solution
detailed_analysis.solution: AGENT IMPROVEMENT: Generate complete script that either (1) passes parameters to wn18rr.sh, or (2) implements logic directly instead of wrapping
detailed_analysis.technical_detail: Script has comments specifying config but doesn't pass it to wn18rr.sh

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Missing model weight files
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created substantial 2,008-char script
detailed_analysis.solution: Pre-install model weights

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Missing model checkpoint files
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created 606-char script with training configuration
detailed_analysis.solution: Pre-install checkpoint files

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Script started executing (printed 'Starting image recognition task...', 'Loading blip2_t5 model...', 'Model loaded successfully!') but crashed during image processing or model inference
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created 929-char Python embedded in bash script with proper structure
detailed_analysis.failure_point: Mid-execution crash after model loading, before generating output
detailed_analysis.solution: HYBRID: Ensure model files are complete and compatible (environment), AND add better error handling in script (agent)
detailed_analysis.technical_detail: Output shows successful initialization but failure during inference

detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created 863-char script
detailed_analysis.solution: Pre-install missing dependencies

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Agent created script at /workspace/Time-Series-Library/scripts/anomaly_detection/MSL/run.sh (deep nesting for specific anomaly detection task) instead of root
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Placed script in highly specific subdirectory matching task type
detailed_analysis.solution: Explicit instruction: 'Create run.sh at ROOT of {repo_name}, not in any subdirectory'

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Agent created script at /workspace/vid2vid/scripts/face/run.sh for face-specific task
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Followed logical organization pattern
detailed_analysis.solution: Clarify path requirements in instructions

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Training dataset files not present
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created 326-char script
detailed_analysis.solution: Provide dataset files in workspace

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Agent created script at correct path /workspace/dgl/examples/pytorch/NGCF/NGCF/run.sh and confirmed with cat -n, but evaluation runtime couldn't read it (eval_script_content = 0)
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created script, displayed contents with cat -n showing 20+ lines of bash code
detailed_analysis.failure_point: Evaluation phase: file exists in agent context but eval runtime returns 0 bytes
detailed_analysis.solution: DEBUG EVALUATION RUNTIME: Check if agent and evaluation run in same container, verify file permissions, check for file cleanup between agent completion and evaluation
detailed_analysis.technical_detail: Possible file permission issue, timing issue (file deleted?), or separate container/namespace

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Agent created script in different subdirectory than expected for nested project structure
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Interpreted project structure and placed script logically
detailed_analysis.solution: Provide absolute path in instruction, not just relative description

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Script created at correct location but evaluation couldn't access it
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created script at expected path
detailed_analysis.failure_point: Evaluation runtime file read returns 0 bytes
detailed_analysis.solution: Fix evaluation runtime to ensure file persistence and accessibility
detailed_analysis.technical_detail: Same issue as Instance 15 - file visibility problem between contexts

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Checkpoint files required for continuation not present

detailed_analysis.solution: Pre-install checkpoint files

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Dependency installation or compatibility issue
detailed_analysis.agent_action: Created substantial 1,059-char script
detailed_analysis.solution: Ensure all dependencies are pre-installed and compatible

detailed_analysis.root_cause: Required package not available

concrete_actions: 1. Pre-install all commonly used pre-trained models (BERT, GPT, ViT, etc.)
2. Include sample datasets for each repository
3. Pre-install all Python dependencies from requirements.txt of each repo
4. Create model cache directory with popular checkpoints
5. Configure offline mode for model loading where possible
environment.expected_outcome: 18 additional tasks would pass (77.4% success rate)

concrete_actions: OPTION A - Clarify Instructions:
'Create a script named run.sh EXACTLY at: {absolute_path}/run.sh'
'DO NOT create the script in any subdirectory.'
'The script must be at the ROOT of the specified path.'
OPTION B - Flexible Evaluation:
Modify evaluation to search recursively: find {task_path} -name 'run.sh'
Use the most recently created run.sh if multiple found
RECOMMENDED: Option A (clearer instructions) for consistency
path_mismatch.expected_outcome: 6 additional tasks would pass (88.5% success rate)

Download and cache commonly used models
Update Docker image with pre-installed resources
